key: Connecting your cities to the capital by Roads and/or Railroads will generate Gold via the Trade Route. You earn more Gold the more Population the City and your Capital has.
en: Connecting your cities to the capital by roads will generate Primeval Stones via the Trade Route. The more people live in the city and in your capital, the more stones you earn.
id: Menghubungkan kota-kotamu ke ibu kota dengan jalan akan menghasilkan Batu Primordial melalui Jalur Perdagangan. Makin banyak penduduk kota itu dan ibu kotamu, makin banyak batu yang kamu dapat.

key: Gold is how you pay for Building Maintenance, Transportation Upkeep, and Unit Upkeep. If you run out of Gold, first you'll receive penalties to your ⍾Science production, then eventually your Units will start Disbanding as you can't pay their upkeep.
en: Primeval Stones are how you pay for Building Maintenance, Transportation Upkeep, and Unit Upkeep. If you run out of Primeval Stones, first you'll receive penalties to your ⍾Science production, then eventually your Units will start Disbanding as you can't pay their upkeep.

key: Note that each road costs 1 Gold Maintenance per turn, and each Railroad costs 2 Gold, so it may be more economical to wait until the cities grow!
en: Note that each road costs 1 Primeval Stone of maintenance per turn, so it may be more economical to wait until the cities grow!
id: Catat bahwa tiap jalan memerlukan biaya pemeliharaan 1 Batu Primordial per giliran, jadi mungkin lebih hemat menunggu sampai kota-kota berkembang!

en: Our people are rejoicing thanks to a festival. For a certain amount of time, any Primeval Stones donation will yield [50]% extra Influence.
